title: The Citizen mirror
notes: His campaign, as far as the curve's test needs: one level, the curve level with him in Vasse's place, so the two can be played side by side.

levels.notes: The power curve's test level with Averno: the same map, raids and seed as Vasse's (vasse-test-3), her first five rounds, his powers and the shared ones offered, and his hand dealing one card from the Ravel Nexus in rounds 2 and 4 (an army bending the schedule). Reached by route: campaign?level=averno-test-1.

mission.name: The curve, pressed
mission.notes: The power curve's test level with Marshal Averno in Vasse's place, so the two Commanders can be played side by side on the same rounds: the same map, raids, reinforcements and seed as hers (vasse-test-3), only the Commander who walks out with the squads differs — and it is her first five rounds. Measured with nothing built, he falls in round 4 and, filed a round late, misses round 5, the heaviest raid, so an empty base cannot hold to her round 6: the forward Commander's cost, which a build behind him pays.

roundText.1: A probe at the ridge. Build what the next rounds need.
roundText.2: Your first building stands: what it leads to is open.
roundText.4: The middle of it. They flank from the east.
roundText.5: Heavier, from two sides. Hold until their schedule ends.
